requirement.description: TypeError in _quotep3 function when trying to call replace() on bytes object instead of string. The error occurs in the quotep function when processing certain inputs.
requirement.contract: Fix the quotep function to properly handle bytes and string conversion when calling replace() method. The function should ensure that both operands are of the same type (strings) before calling replace().

requirement.description: JSONDecodeError when parsing JSON response in test_dots.py::TestDots::test_dk_fk. The JSON parsing fails due to empty or malformed response.
requirement.contract: Ensure proper error handling when parsing JSON responses. When a JSON decode error occurs, the system should gracefully handle the error and return appropriate response instead of failing the entire test.

requirement.description: AssertionError when checking HTTP response codes in test_dedup.py::TestDedup::test_a. The test expects ' 422 Unpro' but gets 'HTTP/1.1 500 Internal Server Error'. This indicates an internal server error during test execution.
requirement.contract: Fix the underlying cause that leads to HTTP 500 Internal Server Error instead of expected 422 Unprocessable Entity. Ensure proper validation and error handling in the deduplication logic.

requirement.description: AssertionError when checking HTTP response codes in test_hooks.py::TestHooks::test. The test expects '201 Created' but gets 'HTTP/1.1 500 Internal Server Error'. This indicates an internal server error during hook execution.
requirement.contract: Fix the underlying cause that leads to HTTP 500 Internal Server Error instead of expected 201 Created during hook processing. Ensure proper hook execution flow and error handling.

requirement.description: AssertionError when checking HTTP response codes in test_httpcli.py::TestHttpCli::test. The test expects a successful response but gets None, indicating a failure in the HTTP client processing.
requirement.contract: Fix the HTTP client processing to properly return expected responses instead of None. Ensure that the HTTP client correctly handles all request types and returns appropriate status codes.
